edits.text: RECITALS. Plaintiff Harrow and Defendant Delmar wish to resolve the claims arising from the dispute between them that is the subject of this Agreement (the “Dispute”).

1. PAYMENT. The Defendant shall pay the Plaintiff USD [AMOUNT TO BE AGREED] (the “Settlement Amount”) within seven days after the date on which both parties have executed this Agreement (the “Effective Date”).

2. RELEASE. Effective only upon the Plaintiff’s receipt of the full Settlement Amount in cleared funds, the Plaintiff releases the Defendant from claims arising from the Dispute. This release does not extend to unrelated claims or obligations under this Agreement.

3. CONFIDENTIALITY. The parties shall keep the terms of this Agreement confidential, except for disclosures required by law, disclosures to their professional advisers, and disclosures reasonably necessary to enforce this Agreement.
